primary_metric.name: mean_per_seed_RMSE
primary_metric.units: original population sigma7 of daily Close log returns; unannualized
primary_metric.definition: Arithmetic mean of RMSE computed separately for every independently fitted neural seed on the exact common support. Not ensemble RMSE and not sqrt of pooled seed MSE.
primary_metric.missing_predictions: reject the run; no silent date deletion or finite replacement

secondary_metrics.MAPE_percent: 100*mean(abs(error)/y) only for y>0; report eligible count and coverage
secondary_metrics.MASE: MAE / mean(abs(y_t-y_(t-1))) from finite consecutive dated training pairs only
secondary_metrics.RMSSE: sqrt(MSE / mean((y_t-y_(t-1))^2)) from the same eligible dated training pairs
secondary_metrics.RMRMSE: RMSE / Persistence RMSE on the same scoring dates; final primary ratio is mean-per-seed RMSE / deterministic Persistence RMSE
secondary_metrics.zero_or_missing_denominators: None plus a stated reason; never an epsilon fallback

HPO.anchor_dates: defined by the parent temporal protocol; never pooled for one global three-anchor HPO winner
HPO.configuration_selection: lowest local arithmetic mean of the two individual validation RMSEs; exact tie -> lowest stable trial_id
HPO.failed_configuration: remains in ledger, consumes its opportunity; no replacement seed or trial
HPO.epoch_selection: strict improvement of original-unit validation RMSE, first checkpoint on ties
HPO.strong_classical: ARIMA eighteen orders p0..2,d0..1,q0..2, deterministic; seasonal naive periods7/14/28 selected locally; Persistence lag1 fixed
HPO.registered_trial_id_domain: The caller must supply the exact eighteen unique IDs returned by the pinned model registry; all eighteen rows must be explicitly completed or failed with a reason.
HPO.incomplete_or_foreign_ledger: Abort before selecting a winner; no partial search may impersonate the registered HPO.
HPO.fatal_or_systematic_failure: Abort selection, even if other configurations completed.
HPO.synthetic_fixture: Explicit scope admits bounded subsets only; reports registered_selection_complete=false and does not close HPO.
HPO.selection_helper_receipts: Criteria only; run artifact bytes and receipts must be independently verified.

NAS.k_gate: freeze after development-only rank-noise pilot and before NAS1

noise_pilot.rule: k40 if any required model median of all ten pairwise seed-rank Spearman correlations is <0.5 or undefined; otherwise k20. A constant ranking or incomplete/censored table cannot be discarded to obtain stability.

NAS.finalist_reference_policy: top k distinct completed finalists; add reference only if not already present; reserve at most k+1
NAS.selection: minimum mean validation RMSE; technical ties to the best if difference<=delta or nominal95% mean-score CI overlaps; fewest parameters, then lower mean RMSE, then stable architecture_id

selection_helper_scope.remaining_gate: The caller must verify the full finalist/seed ledger, phase1 accounting and receipts before declaring NAS selected.

R_planning.pilot_rule: After selection, freeze recipes first; use only the held development pilot for dependence- and multiplicity-aware paired power planning. Do not retune hyperparameters on pilot outcomes.
R_planning.insufficient_power: if required_R>30 or resources do not allow it, report achieved planning sensitivity and MDE; never claim power0.8 merely because R is between6 and30
R_planning.final_seeds: separate registered pool271801..271830; prefix selected only after R is fixed

rules: Keep charges from both historical ledgers, overhead and conservative lost-session charges
Reserve the complete next fit before admitting it; a deficit blocks admission
This amendment neither resets charges nor authorizes more hours

cache_reuse.TiDE_reference_HPO_rule: The same trial at a different selected architecture is not the reference-architecture HPO fit; both architecture_id and architecture_sha256 must match

execution.scope: Rules and pure-helper verification only; live training requires the parent protocol gates and ledger reconciliation
